body.summary: Run both-family production fixtures covering all route matrices, source equivalence, tampering, write windows, native disposal, cancellation and cleanup/migration crashes.
acceptanceChecks: Two independent review sessions remain isolated; full-history writes/native command=0; all mandatory source/test coverage preserved; no user socket/DB or hosted quota used.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.
Through actual registered production review routes, prove native resource and progress writes perform zero full-history mutations for both code and design reviews.
Repeat all t7/t8 route, alias, merge/rename/delete witness, exact-selected-span and latest-subject invariants through actual production defaults for both families.

tests.name: Full disposable production two-session matrix through public routes and both families, all crash/tamper/native-loss cases, complete scope equivalence and bounded runtime writes.
